title: Presentation plan
description: Renderer-neutral semantic structure for an article (AES-P1.6 / SUE-464). Declares what an information block MEANS. How it looks is decided by suengj-com. There is deliberately no field for colour, spacing, component name, or any other visual property — the schema cannot express them.

why.description: Why this information deserves separation. A block that cannot answer this is decoration.

content.description: The block's text, in plain Markdown. No HTML, CSS, colours, or component names — enforced.

fallback.description: The same information as ordinary prose or a plain list. Removing all presentation must lose nothing; enforced by span comparison against content.

claims.description: claim_ids this block asserts. Required for role `evidence`.

artifact_ref.description: Required for role `visual_ref`: the artifact_id of the evidence visual.

role.description: V0.1 allowlist. Deliberately small. Two roles must never differ only by decoration.
